title: Five-series-button navigation cluster

coordinate_system.origin: front UI PCB top-left, viewed from the user-facing side

component.actuation: direct finger press; no separate cap, plunger or custom actuator
component.manufacturer_document: OMRON B3S Sealed Tactile Switch SMT datasheet A204-E1

electrical_contract.simultaneous_press_policy: hardware reports every closed switch independently; firmware rejects contradictory UP+DOWN or LEFT+RIGHT combinations

cost_at_quantity_100_usd.excludes: PCB, assembly, enclosure, freight and tax

h5_acceptance: verify direct finger access through the enclosure openings
verify each direction and OK actuate independently
verify adjacent simultaneous presses remain readable and contradictory pairs are rejected by firmware
verify ordinary actuation, accidental-press margin and sealing-boundary fit on the one assembled front panel without artificial ageing
release_boundary: The five selected controls and their positions close the H1 paper layout. H5 locks source-backed opening geometry and DRC before order; H7/H8 inspect aperture fit, ordinary actuation and accidental-press margin on the one assembled prototype after arrival, with no prescribed-cycle qualification.
